description: This file defines the interface 'DittoProtocolSub' which specifies methods for managing subscriptions to Ditto protocol channels within an actor system. It includes operations for subscribing, unsubscribing, updating streams, declaring acknowledgement labels, and creating instances of the interface.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSub
classes.description: Interface for managing subscriptions and acknowledgements for Ditto protocol channels. Provides methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, updating subscriptions, declaring acknowledgment labels, and factory method for creating instances.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a collection of streaming types and topics with a specified subscriber actor, returning a future that signals completion or failure.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber actor from the subscription management.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the active streaming types and topics for a given subscriber, returning a future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from twin events channel only, based on specified topics.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares global acknowledgement labels for a subscriber, with a future indicating success or potential duplicate label conflict.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations associated with a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DittoProtocolSub instance for a given actor system context.
